title: Adaptive Security Intake: LLM-assisted triage, evidence collector, and priority snapshot
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Summary: Build an adaptive security intake pipeline that combines an LLM-assisted classifier, a lightweight evidence collector UI, and a priority snapshot API for Sales/Support and Solutions engineers. Purpose: reduce manual routing, shorten SLA for enterprise security requests, and standardize evidence bundles for compliance teams. Scope: triage vendor questionnaires, SOC2/ISO pre-sales asks, DPA queries, and GDPR/HIPAA evidence requests. This ticket covers product & PM work: acceptance criteria, runbook, success metrics, and handoff artifacts for Engineering and Design. Implementation work (runtime, storage, UI) will be broken into ENG subtasks.
acceptance_criteria: Automated classifier tags incoming security requests into buckets: information-only, evidence-needed, immediate-escalation within median 10 minutes
Evidence collector UI presents a curated checklist (based on request type) and allows attachment of standard artifacts (SOC2 report, DPA template, data-flow diagram) with progress tracking
Priority Snapshot API returns a single-line priority score (0-100), rationale summary, and required SLA tier for the request for use by Support and Sales
SLA routing rules created: high-priority (<=48h), medium (<=5 business days), low (<=15 business days) and integrated with PagerDuty/escalation paths
Telemetry shows at least 30% reduction in manual reassignments and 20% faster median resolution time in a 4-week pilot
Documentation (runbook + onboarding doc) published and a 1-hour training session delivered to Support and Solutions teams
design_notes: Design intent: minimize friction for customers and AE; default to pre-populated evidence bundles for known customers
UX flows: single-page collector with progressive disclosure, contextual help, and ability to request clarifying questions to customer
Accessibility: ensure file uploader meets keyboard and screen-reader accessibility requirements
implementation_notes: Core components: classifier service (microservice), evidence-bundles S3 store, collector UI embedded in Support ticket view, Priority Snapshot endpoint
LLM classifier: deterministic prompt + lightweight fine-tuned classifier; provide confidence score and match to checklist templates
Security: all customer artifacts encrypted at rest; KMS-managed keys; audit log events for upload/download
Data retention: evidence bundles retained 2 years by default with admin purge option
Rate limits: collector UI uploads rate-limited to protect storage costs; chunked uploads for large PDFs
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Pilot): internal alpha with Solutions team and 15 existing enterprise customers for 4 weeks
Phase 1 (Wider pilot): open to enterprise accounts with support opt-in; collect feedback and metrics for 6 weeks
Phase 2 (GA): release in console-2025.11, enable opt-out per-org control and SLA configuration
Rollback: route requests back to manual triage and disable LLM classifier flag
metrics: Triage median latency (time from request creation to assigned bucket)
Evidence completeness rate (percent of requests submitted with all required artifacts)
Pilot NPS from Solutions team and customer feedback
risks_and_mitigations: Classifier false positives/negatives: run an initial shadow mode for 2 weeks and require human approval for high-confidence escalations
Sensitive data exposure: enforce client-side encryption for uploads when requested and add metadata-only listing for preview
Operational load: cap concurrent uploads and provide backpressure UI messaging
Legal/regulatory variance: include region-aware checklist templates (EU vs US) and route special cases to Compliance SME
